record.question: In which sampling method are all members of a population equally to be likely selected?
record.explanation: Official final key: D — Simple Random. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 5, printed Q22. Source limitation: Equal individual inclusion probability alone does not uniquely imply simple random sampling: equal-sized cluster,proportionate stratified and systematic designs can also give equal chances. SRS additionally specifies random selection/equal probability of possible fixed-size samples; the stem needs that distinguishing condition. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
